candidats.description: Drywall assembly required to have a fire-resistance rating, defeated by on site reality with absent firestops , mud and tape.
Various sized cuts of 1/2 inch drywall with tools for maintenance and installation
Finished, painted, fire-resistance rated drywall assembly. A common deficiency: Lift ceiling tiles and find electrical and mechanical service penetrations without a firestop .

candidats.description: A code violation waiting to happen: In this case, penetrants have been punched and burned through a drywall assembly required to have a fire-resistance rating. The integrity of the drywall has been seriously compromised at the through-penetration and will be fixed with nothing but drywall mud, whereas a solidly framed opening could have been spared out and sealed in a manner preserving bounding by a speciality firestop subcontractor.
